notes: Verification pattern that works here: query coordinates, never screenshots (they come back black) and never playtest logs (capture returns nothing). Rotation-aware AABBs matter - naive Position +/- Size/2 is badly wrong for rotated cylinders and has produced false alarms twice.
Build scripts live in casino/builds/, client in casino/client/, server in casino/server/. All are idempotent and were run twice to prove it.
set_script_source tops out around 22KB; larger scripts are pasted in two parts using a --@@SPLIT@@ marker.
Bash heredocs in this environment choke on large Lua payloads (apostrophes break the quoting). Use the Write tool for whole files and Python inline for surgical patches.

Two pre-existing modelling bugs found and reported: poker and roulette chair backs were on the table side, so those chairs already faced away from their own table; and four WallSign neons were stacked back-to-front behind the wall.
